title: Carbachol´s Headache Inducing Characteristics and Effects on the Cerebral Blood Flow
brief_summary: To investigate headache score and accompanying symptoms during and after infusion of carbachol.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy volunteers
* Aged 18-40
* 50-100 kg
* Fertile women must use safe contraceptives (IUD, oral contraceptives, surgical sterilisation and long lasting gestagen.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Tension type headache more than once/month
* Other primary headaches
* Daily medication except contraceptives
* Drug taken within 4 times the halflife for the specific drug except contraceptives
* Pregnant or lactating women
* Exposure to radiation within the last year
* Headache within the last 24 hours before start of trial
* Hypertension
* Hypotension
* Respiratory or cardiac disease
